headline: Morning World: 116th-Year Budget Revenue and Expenditure Both Exceed NT$3.9 Trillion; Defense Exceeds 3% of GDP | Life
summary: The Executive Yuan approved the 116th-year central government budget on the 20th, with revenue and expenditure each above NT$3.9 trillion. Defense, social welfare and local government subsidies each exceed NT$1 trillion.
why: A government budget sets fiscal spending and revenue targets, which shape deficits, public debt and economic demand.
